push.title: W 4-0 vs Gerth United | You: 9.4 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
A 9.4 against Gerth United, tuxedo_slide. If I had a hat I'd tip it, then I'd buy a second hat just to tip that one too.

DID WELL
+ 2 key passes. Chances like that are gifts. You were Santa out there.
+ A brace against Gerth United. The net said thank you, and so do I.
+ Man of the Match. The game noticed, and so did I.
+ That connection with PhogsToffees is the real deal. Find 'em early and often.
+ 2 shots on target nudged you up +0.1. Every bit counts.

WORK ON
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
- 67% passing (14 of 21). Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
- You and BellyTb1 were both flagged for defensive work rate. Fix it as a pair: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Passes attempted: 21. That's a B. The A-students among midfielders are at 25+.

Coach's drill: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

Keep doing you. You're doing great at it. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.7 against Gerth United. That's top-25% forward work, and it didn't happen by accident.

WORK ON

- Funny thing: tuxedo_slide wrestled with forcing passes too. Two heads, one fix: give each other short options.

Before next match: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

That's the stuff. Same time next match? - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-0 vs Gerth United | You: 7.8 (above average MID)
push.body:
Good stuff, BellyTb1. A 7.8 against Gerth United. Not fireworks, but a nice warm campfire.

DID WELL
+ A goal against Gerth United. Never gets old, and I hope it never does.
+ We beat Gerth United 4-0. Wins taste better when everybody chipped in.

WORK ON
- 63% passing (12 of 19). Real talk: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.
- Only 2 tackles attempted. When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
- 1 goal from 3 on target. Between you and me: Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard.
- You and tuxedo_slide, same defensive work rate homework. Partners: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Passes attempted: 19. Halfway up the mountain. The view from 25+ is something else.

Practice this: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.

Tomorrow's a fresh pitch. Let's go make some divots. - Coach Lasso
